mechanism_narrative: A federal funds rate below 0.5% compresses the risk-free rate, reducing equity discount rates and driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when FEDFUNDS < 0.5%.

mechanism_narrative: Unemployment rate exceeding 7.5% signals labor market deterioration that triggers equity sell-offs, causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are positive in more than 60% of periods when UNRATE > 7.5%.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous declines in housing starts (HOUST) and retail sales (RSAFS) signal broad consumer demand contraction, driving negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of periods when both HOUST and RSAFS decline.

mechanism_narrative: High inflation (CPIAUCSL YoY > 3.0%) triggers restrictive monetary policy, causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are positive in more than 60% of periods when CPIAUCSL YoY > 3.0%.

mechanism_narrative: Declining industrial production (INDPRO) indicates real economy weakening, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of periods when INDPRO declines.

mechanism_narrative: Nonfarm payrolls growth below 50 (thousand persons) signals labor market slowdown that reduces consumer spending, driving negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are positive in more than 60% of periods when PAYEMS growth < 50.

mechanism_narrative: Slowing GDP growth (GDPC1) combined with rising interest rates (FEDFUNDS) signals monetary tightening that reduces corporate profitability, causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of periods when GDPC1 declines and FEDFUNDS rises.

mechanism_narrative: In late economic expansion regimes, declining housing starts (HOUST) signals impending slowdown, driving negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are positive in more than 60% of periods when HOUST declines in late expansion regimes.
